blocks.text: Draft for Jared's approval. Built from the boards' September 2026 statistics, the monthly SnapStats figures and Jared's MLS® closed sales (Nov 2025 to Oct 2026). No live feed filtered to this home type yet.

Burnaby condos for sale: apartment-style homes in strata buildings. The Greater Vancouver REALTORS® benchmark for apartments (condos) in Burnaby was $708,100 in September 2026 (-5.5% over a year). Before you offer, read the strata documents: the depreciation report, meeting minutes, bylaws and fees.
Burnaby condos sold, November 2025 to October 2026

1,512 condos sold in Burnaby with a median price of $645,000 (the middle half sold between $540,000 and $768,250), taking a median of 29 days to sell at 97.0% of the last list price; 7% sold above list. They had a median $824 per square foot, a median year built of 2015 and a median strata fee of $455 a month.

blocks.text: Before you buy condos in Burnaby
Jared checks these with you on the exact address before you write an offer:
More Burnaby real estate
Burnaby Condos: streets and boundaries

items.t: Burnaby's condo stock is organized by four town centres, because the City's growth framework concentrates apartment growth there: Metrotown is the City Centre, and Brentwood, Lougheed and Edmonds are the Town Centres.
Each centre sits on a SkyTrain station of the same name: Metrotown and Edmonds on the Expo Line, Brentwood on the Millennium Line, and Lougheed Town Centre where the two lines meet.

blocks.text: Burnaby Condos: the housing stock

items.t: The framework sets the built form by tier: residential development in the City Centre of Metrotown is primarily high-rise, while the Town Centres of Brentwood, Lougheed and Edmonds are primarily apartments ranging from high-rise to mid-rise towers.

Lougheed's index cluster sits on Government Street and Carrigan Court — Sandlewood at 9233 and 9283 Government Street and Discovery Place at 3980 Carrigan Court — while Edmonds' fronts Kingsway: Kings Crossing 1 at 7388 Kingsway, Kings Crossing 2 at 7358 Edmonds Street and Toscana at 7738 Edmonds Street.

blocks.text: Burnaby Condos: rules that affect buyers

items.t: City-wide, every strata of five or more lots must hold a depreciation report on a five-year cycle since July 1, 2024, with no deferral vote; that duty reaches every tower in all four town centres.

Rezoning bylaws for new towers are now amendments to the Burnaby Zoning Bylaw 2026, and since the 2023 provincial changes, public hearings are neither required nor prohibited for specified residential rezonings, though public notice still applies before first reading.

blocks.text: Burnaby Condos: local details a buyer would not know

items.t: Burnaby has no single downtown: the framework names Metrotown alone as City Centre, above the three Town Centres.
The same framework lists Rapid Transit Urban Villages — Bainbridge, Broadview, Garden Village, the Heights, Holdom, Lake City, Lochdale and Royal Oak — as a separate tier below the Town Centres.
School District No. 41 (SD41) serves the whole city; its elementary list runs from Chaffey-Burke at 4404 Sardis Street to Edmonds Community at 7651 18th Avenue.
New strata buildings begin tax life under a developer's parent folio until the City's apportionment process creates child-unit tax notices.
StreetFest on Central closes Central Boulevard and Beresford Street between Patterson and Willingdon Avenues, below the Metrotown towers, each Canada Day.

blocks.text: Burnaby Condos: development and new projects

items.t: Rezoning Reference #25-25, amendment to Rezoning Reference #18-43 (Bylaw No. 14299, adopted December 16, 2024): the earlier approval permitted a six-storey, 69-unit rental building with commercial podium and a 41-storey, 359-unit strata tower with townhouses at grade; the amendment proposes a six-storey strata building of approximately 142 units and a 27-storey rental tower of approximately 276 units with a two-storey commercial podium. Status: presented for first and second reading at the July 28, 2026 Council meeting (as of November 3, 2026).

Town centre plan status: the Burnaby 2050 Official Community Plan growth framework carries the four-centre structure forward, with the City Centre at Metrotown and Town Centres at Brentwood, Lougheed and Edmonds.

blocks.text: Burnaby Condos: costs and taxes

items.t: Burnaby's 2026 property taxes were due July 3, 2026, after which a 5% late penalty applies, with a further 5% after the September due date.
The 2026 tax sale was set for September 28, 2026 at Burnaby City Hall, for parcels with taxes unpaid for the two prior years — the end point of the penalty ladder a strata owner ignores.

blocks.text: Burnaby Condos: getting around

items.t: The Millennium Line serves Brentwood Town Centre and Lougheed Town Centre stations across north Burnaby, per the framework's transit-based growth model for the four centres.

blocks.text: Burnaby Condos: risks and due diligence

items.t: Start with rental replacement: the Beresford Street application in the Central Park note includes 112 required rental replacement units, a condition type that signals an older rental building is being redeveloped — check whether a target building sits in a rezoning assembly.
Check the depreciation report deadline against the building's last report date: pre-2021 reports expired for compliance purposes on July 1, 2026 in Metro Vancouver.

blocks.text: Jared's take on Burnaby
Burnaby is a city of distinct pockets. Metrotown, Brentwood, Edmonds and the north-slope neighbourhoods all feel very different, with Deer Lake as the park heart of the older neighbourhoods.
Burnaby houses

faq.q: What did condos in Burnaby sell for?
faq.a: 1,512 condos sold in Burnaby between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026, with a median price of $645,000.

faq.q: How long do condos take to sell in Burnaby?
faq.a: The median was 29 days from listing to sale, and homes sold at a median 97.0% of the last list price (7% sold above list), for sales November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.

faq.q: What price range do most condos in Burnaby sell in?
faq.a: The middle half of the 1,512 condos that sold in Burnaby went for between $540,000 and $768,250, around a median of $645,000.

faq.q: Do condos in Burnaby sell above asking price?
faq.a: 7% of the 1,512 condos sold for more than the last list price, and the median sale was 97.0% of it.

faq.q: What is a typical strata fee for condos in Burnaby?
faq.a: Of the 1,512 sales, 1506 listings gave a monthly fee and the median was $455.

faq.q: How old are the condos that sold in Burnaby?
faq.a: The median year built was 2015 for the 1,512 condos sold in Burnaby.

faq.q: How many bedrooms do condos in Burnaby usually have?
faq.a: The median condo that sold in Burnaby had 2 bedrooms, from the 1,512 sales between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.

faq.q: Which Burnaby communities sold the most condos?
faq.a: By number sold: Brentwood Park (490), Metrotown (410), Sullivan Heights (97), for November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.

faq.q: Which Burnaby buildings sold the most condos?
faq.a: By number sold: City of Lougheed (28), Gilmore Place (26), Amazing Brentwood (19), for November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.

faq.q: What is the benchmark price of a condo in Burnaby?
faq.a: The Greater Vancouver REALTORS® MLS® Home Price Index benchmark for apartments (condos) in Burnaby (Burnaby East) was $708,100 in September 2026, a modelled price for a typical home and not an average of sales.

faq.q: Did condo prices fall in Burnaby?
faq.a: Over the past year the benchmark fell 5.5%. Over three months it was little changed (-0.2%, under the 1.5% we need before calling it a move). A change under 1.5% is not described as a rise or fall.

faq.q: Is Burnaby a buyers’ or sellers’ market?
faq.a: In October 2026 houses in Burnaby had a sales ratio of 12%, which the reports’ scale reads as a balanced market, and condos and townhomes 13%, which the reports’ scale reads as a balanced market. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.

faq.q: How many condos are for sale in Burnaby?
faq.a: The listing feed on this page shows what is active now, and the number changes daily. Ask Jared and he will send you the condos in Burnaby that match what you want.
